event.title: Xverse launched Lightning payments through Sati
event.description: Xverse announced on 2026-01-26 that Lightning Network payments had launched in partnership with Sati and were available from the Xverse web wallet, while the user's main Bitcoin wallet remained self-custodial.

evidence.title: Xverse Gets a Lightning Fast Upgrade in Partnership With Sati
evidence.notes: First-party Xverse announcement explicitly states that Lightning Network payments launched through the Sati partnership.
